user.title: Connect controller
user.description: Enter a session cookie or API token. Disabling certificate verification for a self-signed certificate leaves server identity unchecked. Do not share credentials in chat.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew session
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in to your controller again and enter fresh session credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach controller or decode its FIN response.
error.invalid_config: Check HTTPS URL, project and provide at least one credential.

init.title: Polling and controls
init.description: Controls change FIN default values. Schedules and manual overrides may take precedence. Writes have not been verified against real hardware.
